performance.en: Performance: She speaks to the camera calmly and naturally as if mid-conversation, with natural jaw and lip movement and a relaxed rhythm. Her eyes stay on the lens, she blinks naturally, head turns stay within 20 degrees, and her hands stay out of view below the frame the whole time. Home pose: head centered and facing the lens, shoulders relaxed and level, hands resting together low and out of view below the bottom edge of the frame, lips relaxed. Energy: medium — natural conversational nods and small eyebrow movements.
performance.zh: 表演：她像正在对话一样，平静自然地对着镜头说话，下颌与嘴唇自然运动，节奏放松。视线始终看镜头，自然眨眼，头部转动不超过 20 度，双手全程在画面底边以下不入画。回位姿势：头部居中面向镜头，双肩放松、水平，双手放低并拢在画面底边以下（不入画），嘴唇放松。能量：中——自然的对话式点头和细微的眉毛动作。

avoid.en: Avoid: hands touching or covering the face or mouth, head turned more than 20 degrees, hair crossing the face, jewelry, glasses, patterned clothing, logos, text, subtitles, camera movement, zoom, cuts, lighting changes, extra people, objects in the background, hands entering the frame, frowning, laughing.
avoid.zh: 避免：手触碰或遮挡脸和嘴，头部转动超过 20 度，头发遮挡脸部，首饰，眼镜，有图案的服装，logo，文字，字幕，镜头运动，变焦，剪辑，光线变化，其他人物，背景杂物，手进入画面，皱眉，大笑。

timeline.en: She holds the home pose, then begins speaking.
timeline.zh: 保持回位姿势，然后开始说话。

timeline.en: Mid-sentence she pauses for half a beat with her lips closed, as if choosing the right word, then continues with a small nod.
timeline.zh: 说到一半，双唇闭合停顿半拍，像在挑一个合适的词，然后轻轻点头继续说。

timeline.en: She returns to the home pose and holds it still for one second.
timeline.zh: 回到回位姿势，静止保持一秒。

timeline.en: She stops speaking and listens with her lips gently closed, a soft closed-lip smile, one slow nod and a natural blink.
timeline.zh: 她停止说话，双唇轻闭地倾听，带着闭唇浅笑缓慢点头一次，自然眨眼。

timeline.en: She returns to the home pose and holds it still for one second.
timeline.zh: 回到回位姿势，静止保持一秒。

timeline.en: Calm and focused for a serious point: steady gaze, eyebrows drawn very slightly together in concentration (not frowning), and one slow nod.
timeline.zh: 讲严肃观点时平静专注：目光坚定，眉头因专注而极轻微地收拢（不是皱眉），缓慢点头一次。

timeline.en: She returns to the home pose and holds it still for one second.
timeline.zh: 回到回位姿势，静止保持一秒。

timeline.en: Two quick small nods as if saying "right?", with a small confident smile.
timeline.zh: 连续两个快速的小点头，像在说“对吧？”，带一点笃定的浅笑。

timeline.en: She finishes her sentence, returns to the home pose and holds it still until the end, the final frame matching the first frame as closely as possible.
timeline.zh: 说完这句话，回到回位姿势，静止保持到结束，最后一帧尽量与第一帧一致。

7–8 秒：回到回位姿势，静止保持一秒。

21–22 秒：回到回位姿势，静止保持一秒。
22–28 秒：连续两个快速的小点头，像在说“对吧？”，带一点笃定的浅笑。
28–30 秒：说完这句话，回到回位姿势，静止保持到结束，最后一帧尽量与第一帧一致。

timeline.en: She holds the home pose, then begins speaking.

timeline.en: She returns to the home pose and holds it still for one second.

timeline.zh: 说完这句话，回到回位姿势，静止保持到结束，最后一帧尽量与第一帧一致。

人物：与参考图中同一位三十出头的东亚女性：黑色及肩发整齐地扎成低马尾，脸旁没有碎发，淡妆，身穿纯色藏青西装外套，内搭素白圆领上衣，不戴首饰，不戴眼镜。
场景与光线：身后是纯净的浅暖灰无缝墙，照明均匀，画面中没有其他物体。镜头左侧 45 度大面积柔光主光，镜头右侧柔和补光，身后细微的发丝轮廓光，5600K 中性白平衡，整个镜头曝光恒定。写实，真实皮肤纹理，脸部焦点清晰，自然色彩，细腻胶片颗粒，无闪烁。安静的室内环境声，无音乐。
表演：她像正在对话一样，平静自然地对着镜头说话，下颌与嘴唇自然运动，节奏放松。视线始终看镜头，自然眨眼，头部转动不超过 20 度，双手全程在画面底边以下不入画。回位姿势：头部居中面向镜头，双肩放松、水平，双手放低并拢在画面底边以下（不入画），嘴唇放松。能量：中——自然的对话式点头和细微的眉毛动作。
时间线：
0–1 秒：保持回位姿势，然后开始说话。
1–7 秒：平稳、从容地叙述，每句话末尾缓慢点头一次，肩部保持不动。
7–8 秒：回到回位姿势，静止保持一秒。
8–14 秒：说到一半，双唇闭合停顿半拍，像在挑一个合适的词，然后轻轻点头继续说。
14–15 秒：回到回位姿势，静止保持一秒。
15–21 秒：她稍稍收拢目光、压低一点声音，像在分享一件重要的事，缓慢点头一次。
21–22 秒：回到回位姿势，静止保持一秒。
22–28 秒：连续三个快速的小点头，像在肯定自己的观点。
28–30 秒：说完这句话，回到回位姿势，静止保持到结束，最后一帧尽量与第一帧一致。
避免：手触碰或遮挡脸和嘴，头部转动超过 20 度，头发遮挡脸部，首饰，眼镜，有图案的服装，logo，文字，字幕，镜头运动，变焦，剪辑，光线变化，其他人物，背景杂物，手进入画面，皱眉，大笑。

performance.en: Performance: She speaks to the camera calmly and naturally as if mid-conversation, with natural jaw and lip movement and a relaxed rhythm. Her eyes stay on the lens, she blinks naturally, head turns stay within 20 degrees, and her hands stay out of view below the frame the whole time. Home pose: head centered and facing the lens, shoulders relaxed and level, hands resting together low and out of view below the bottom edge of the frame, lips relaxed. Energy: medium — natural conversational nods and small eyebrow movements.
performance.zh: 表演：她像正在对话一样，平静自然地对着镜头说话，下颌与嘴唇自然运动，节奏放松。视线始终看镜头，自然眨眼，头部转动不超过 20 度，双手全程在画面底边以下不入画。回位姿势：头部居中面向镜头，双肩放松、水平，双手放低并拢在画面底边以下（不入画），嘴唇放松。能量：中——自然的对话式点头和细微的眉毛动作。

avoid.en: Avoid: hands touching or covering the face or mouth, head turned more than 20 degrees, hair crossing the face, jewelry, glasses, patterned clothing, logos, text, subtitles, camera movement, zoom, cuts, lighting changes, extra people, objects in the background, hands entering the frame, frowning, laughing.

R04.negative: hands touching face, hand covering mouth, profile view, head turned away, looking away, hair over face, jewelry, earrings, glasses, patterned clothing, logo, text, subtitles, watermark, camera movement, zoom, cut, jump cut, flicker, lighting change, extra people, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, plastic skin, hands in frame, frowning, angry, laughing, wide open mouth

timeline.en: She holds the home pose, then begins speaking.
timeline.zh: 保持回位姿势，然后开始说话。

timeline.en: Mid-sentence she pauses for half a beat with her lips closed, as if choosing the right word, then continues with a small nod.
timeline.zh: 说到一半，双唇闭合停顿半拍，像在挑一个合适的词，然后轻轻点头继续说。

timeline.en: She returns to the home pose and holds it still for one second.
timeline.zh: 回到回位姿势，静止保持一秒。

timeline.en: Three quick small nods in a row as if agreeing with her own point.
timeline.zh: 连续三个快速的小点头，像在肯定自己的观点。

timeline.en: She returns to the home pose and holds it still for one second.
timeline.zh: 回到回位姿势，静止保持一秒。

timeline.en: She narrows her focus slightly and lowers her voice as if sharing something important, one slow nod.
timeline.zh: 她稍稍收拢目光、压低一点声音，像在分享一件重要的事，缓慢点头一次。

timeline.en: She returns to the home pose and holds it still for one second.
timeline.zh: 回到回位姿势，静止保持一秒。

timeline.en: A brief thoughtful glance up and to the left as if recalling something, then her eyes come back to the lens and she continues with a small knowing nod.
timeline.zh: 像在回想什么，目光短暂地向左上方看一下，随即回到镜头，带着心中有数的小点头继续说。

timeline.en: She finishes her sentence, returns to the home pose and holds it still until the end, the final frame matching the first frame as closely as possible.
timeline.zh: 说完这句话，回到回位姿势，静止保持到结束，最后一帧尽量与第一帧一致。

R04.prompt_en:
30-second single continuous shot, locked-off camera on a tripod, no camera movement, no zoom, no cuts. 9:16 vertical. Medium close-up from mid-chest up, subject centered, eyes on the upper third line, a little headroom.
Identity: the same East Asian woman in her early thirties as in the reference image — shoulder-length black hair neatly tied back in a low ponytail with no loose strands near the face, natural makeup, wearing a solid navy blazer over a plain white crew-neck top, no jewelry, no glasses.
Setting and light: plain warm light-grey seamless wall behind her, evenly lit, nothing else in frame. Large soft key light 45 degrees from camera left, soft fill from camera right, subtle hair rim light from behind, neutral 5600K white balance, constant exposure for the whole shot. Photorealistic, true-to-life skin texture, sharp focus on the face, natural color, fine film grain, no flicker. Quiet room tone, no music.
Performance: She speaks to the camera calmly and naturally as if mid-conversation, with natural jaw and lip movement and a relaxed rhythm. Her eyes stay on the lens, she blinks naturally, head turns stay within 20 degrees, and her hands stay out of view below the frame the whole time. Home pose: head centered and facing the lens, shoulders relaxed and level, hands resting together low and out of view below the bottom edge of the frame, lips relaxed. Energy: medium — natural conversational nods and small eyebrow movements.
Timeline:
0–1s: She holds the home pose, then begins speaking.
1–7s: Mid-sentence she pauses for half a beat with her lips closed, as if choosing the right word, then continues with a small nod.
7–8s: She returns to the home pose and holds it still for one second.
8–14s: Three quick small nods in a row as if agreeing with her own point.
14–15s: She returns to the home pose and holds it still for one second.
15–21s: She narrows her focus slightly and lowers her voice as if sharing something important, one slow nod.
21–22s: She returns to the home pose and holds it still for one second.
22–28s: A brief thoughtful glance up and to the left as if recalling something, then her eyes come back to the lens and she continues with a small knowing nod.
28–30s: She finishes her sentence, returns to the home pose and holds it still until the end, the final frame matching the first frame as closely as possible.
Avoid: hands touching or covering the face or mouth, head turned more than 20 degrees, hair crossing the face, jewelry, glasses, patterned clothing, logos, text, subtitles, camera movement, zoom, cuts, lighting changes, extra people, objects in the background, hands entering the frame, frowning, laughing.
